proof_summary: Writing the rank as \(n+\lfloor e^{H_n}-1\rfloor\), bounds on \(e^{H_n}\) together with \(e^t\ge 1+t\) and the Padé inequality \(e^t(2-t)\le 2+t\) give \(1\le e^{H_{n+1}}-e^{H_n}<2\), so the floor increment has only the two required possibilities.  Telescoping their counts and using \(e^{H_n}/n\to e^\gamma\) yields the limiting quotient \((e^\gamma-1)/(2-e^\gamma)\); monotone harmonic–log bounds and finite series estimates give \(16/9<e^\gamma<41/23\), placing this quotient strictly between \(3.5\) and \(3.6\).
